resources.string: Caution: Certain launchers may not handle app icon customisation correctly. If the icon disappears, attempt launching the app through Google Play or a widget, if accessible. After launching, restore the default green icon colour #106D1F. In extreme cases, reinstalling the app may be necessary.

Don\'t forget that if you uninstall any paid app within 2 hours, you will automatically be refunded. If you want a refund any time later, just contact us at hello@fossify.org and you will get it. That makes it easy to try it out :)
